pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches on the neck and upper flank exhibit sharp-edged geometry with high-contrast pixel gradients. On the upper neck, patches are large and polygonal with straight edges, while on the visible flank, the patches appear smaller and more irregular in shape.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous topological lattice. Corridors are narrowest on the neck and increase in pixel width on the lower flank. Junction nodes are predominantly three-way intersections with high continuity where not occluded by foreground vegetation.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a continuous, finely serrated 1D profile against the sky. The silhouette is composed of short, vertical hair clusters creating a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged edge.
